steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each unit is placed by its span of control against the target range and its layer count against the target.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 span is outside the target range

findings.title: Layer count above the target
findings.fix: Remove a layer or justify it

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] unit-b-span.csv:12  Span outside the target range.
       Fix: Review the unit's structure.
[medium] layers.csv:19  Layer count above the target.
       Fix: Remove a layer or justify it.
[low] unit-d-span.csv:26  Unit with no span figure.
       Fix: Add the span.
Not checked: Work content behind each span.
pros: Checks a span outside the target range, and a layer count above the target.
cons: Not checked: Work content behind each span.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-span-layer-analysis skill on the records for this review.
